problem: The Passing Yards quarterback picker renders oversized player/team images on mobile and enters the expensive selected-player analysis stack before a quarterback is selected, making the initial picker visually oversized and slower than necessary.
root_cause: The live Passing Yards owner always enters frozen V87/V86/V85 and the historical picker is composed only after the deep Passing Yards chain has already executed. Legacy image classes also inherit later responsive overrides that can make picker headshots/team logos fill most of the mobile card.
repair: Additive V88 fast-picker owner uses only verified slate plus exact quarterback identity before player selection, renders isolated compact cards with hard image bounds and lazy/async image hints, returns without importing the selected-player analysis owner, and delegates selected quarterback requests unchanged to frozen V87. V239 advances only the Passing Yards hub pointer from V87 to V88.
acceptance: V88 is presentation/performance-only and keeps V87 as the selected-QB owner.
V88 has no top-level Streamlit, pandas, Passing Yards hub, or identity imports.
The unselected route loads verified slate plus exact QB identity only and returns without V87.
The selected route delegates unchanged to frozen V87.
QB headshots are hard-bounded to 112px desktop, 96px mobile, and 84px narrow-mobile CSS sizes.
Team logos are hard-bounded to 56px desktop, 44px mobile, and 38px narrow-mobile CSS sizes.
Image elements keep explicit width/height plus lazy loading, async decoding, and low fetch priority.
V239 advances only Passing Yards ownership to V88 and preserves non-Passing-Yards delegation.
